description: This file defines the BuildSettings class and related functions for managing build configuration in a build system, including paths, version requirements, and callbacks.

classes.name: BuildSettings
classes.description: Class managing build configuration settings such as paths, version requirements, and callbacks.

methods.name: set_arg_file_template_path
methods.description: Sets the argument file template path.

methods.name: build_args
methods.description: Returns a reference to the build arguments.

methods.name: GetFullPath
methods.description: Returns the full absolute path for a given source file.

methods.name: GetFullPathSecondary
methods.description: Returns the full path inside the secondary source path.

methods.name: ItemDefined
methods.description: Called when an item is defined from a background thread.

methods.name: set_item_defined_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for item definition.

methods.name: swap_print_callback
methods.description: Swaps the current print callback with a new one.

methods.name: exec_script_allowlist
methods.description: Returns the list of files allowed to call exec_script.

methods.name: set_exec_script_allowlist
methods.description: Sets the list of files allowed to call exec_script.
